title: THE SWING wins Best Director and Best Actress
summary: BLACKCLAP's English-language physical theatre production THE SWING received two awards at the Colombo International Theatre Festival 2026.
body: THE SWING, an English-language physical theatre production by BLACKCLAP FILM & THEATRE PRODUCTIONS, received the Best Director and Best Actress awards at the Colombo International Theatre Festival 2026.
The production was also selected to participate in the National Youth Theatre Festival 2026.
THE SWING was written by Shashi Donpawulu and directed by Yasiru Sandaruwan Weerasinghe, with Madara Peries in the leading role.

title: 6 + (1) kmph wins Best Short Film, Best Director and Best Screenwriter
summary: The short film 6 + (1) kmph won three awards at the Onscreen 25 Short Film Festival.
body: 6 + (1) kmph, a short film inspired by a true story, received the Best Short Film, Best Director and Best Screenwriter awards at the Onscreen 25 Short Film Festival.
The film was also a finalist at the Agenda 14 Short Film Festival 2025 and the Third Act Short Film Festival 2026, and was selected for screening at the Out of the Frame Short Film Festival 2026.
It has also been used as an educational reference by film educators when teaching filmmaking and cinema to students.

title: PETLE OF LULLABY selected as a finalist at Third Act Short Film Festival
summary: A short film by Shashi Donpawulu was selected as a finalist at the Third Act Short Film Festival 2026.
body: PETLE OF LULLABY, a short film by Shashi Donpawulu, was selected as a finalist at the Third Act Short Film Festival 2026.
The film's tagline is The Death of a Sleeping Sigh.
